# Disagreement Log — GTH_107

**Date:** 2026-03-17
**Saying:** 107
**Agents:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA

---

## Disagreements

| # | Verse | EMET | LOGOS | PNEUMA | Issue |
|---|-------|------|-------|--------|-------|
| 1 | 107 | "the largest" | "the biggest" | "The largest one" | Size superlative: largest vs. biggest |
| 2 | 107 | "sought the one" | "looked for the one" | "searched until" | Seeking verb: sought vs. looked for vs. searched |
| 3 | 107 | "When he had gone to this trouble" | "After all his toil" | "When he had put himself through all that trouble" | Effort acknowledgment phrasing |

**Total disagreements: 3**

---

**Resolution:** SOPHIA adopts "the largest" (more elevated than "biggest"), "sought" (Thomas's seeking vocabulary), and "When he had gone to this trouble" (EMET's phrasing preserves the Coptic tone).
